customer_segment: End consumers seeking hydration who choose packaged beverages (often buying in retail or online channels)
end_activity: Decide whether to repurchase the same packaged-water brand/channel or switch to another hydration option

activities.customer_goal: Notice thirst / desire for hydration and decide to get water (or another beverage)

activities.activity: Search for feasible hydration options available right now
activities.current_provider: self (memory/habit); nearby availability via retail/vending/online; alternatives include tap water and other beverages
activities.customer_goal: Identify what options are accessible given location, time, and constraints (tap vs packaged water vs other drinks)

activities.activity: Evaluate and compare options (brand, price, convenience, perceived health, packaging)
activities.current_provider: incumbent beverage brands and Liquid Death (branding/packaging cues); retailers (shelf placement, assortment, pricing)
activities.customer_goal: Choose the option that best fits preferences and tradeoffs (cost, convenience, brand appeal, packaging)

activities.activity: Purchase the chosen product through an available channel
activities.current_provider: retailers (grocery, convenience), vending, or online; Liquid Death and incumbents supply product into these channels
activities.customer_goal: Complete the transaction quickly and obtain the product with minimal friction

activities.activity: Consume the water and handle the packaging after use
activities.current_provider: self (drinks); local waste/recycling systems (disposal); product packaging format influences the experience
activities.customer_goal: Get hydration and then dispose/recycle the container with minimal hassle

activities.activity: Reflect on experience (including environmental impact) and decide whether to repurchase
activities.current_provider: self (preference/loyalty formation); brand messaging and past experience influence recall and loyalty
activities.customer_goal: Decide to buy again, switch brands, switch channels, or revert to tap/other beverages based on satisfaction and concerns

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: Company profile emphasizes end-consumer hydration choice and differentiation via bold marketing/packaging (E3, E8, E9, E11), but the customer value chain includes a distinct post-consumption step where consumers consider disposal and environmental impact as part of the overall job (E12, E13).
